unbounded-tmux-output.help: Use the bounded tmux command runner instead of buffering a subprocess directly.
unbounded-tmux-output.message: tmux subprocess output must be capped and timeout-bound.

unsafe-tmux-process-control.help: Use safe process-group APIs and nix signal wrappers; do not add unsafe process control here.
unsafe-tmux-process-control.message: tmux subprocess lifecycle must not introduce unsafe code.

title: tmux subprocesses must remain bounded and safe
